resources.string: Calendar feed for iPhone and other calendars
A read-only link to your family calendar
Calendar for other apps
Make a read-only link that Apple Calendar on an iPhone — or any calendar app that can subscribe to a web address — keeps up to date. The other app refreshes it about once an hour.
Included: custody days and contact times, each with the parent\'s name, and the events you share with your co-parent.
Not included: private events, chat, expenses and children\'s records. Nothing can be changed from the other calendar; changes are made here, in CoPlanly.
Anyone who has the link can see this calendar. Send it only to the person it is for, and revoke it here if it goes further. A link no calendar has opened for 90 days stops working.
